user.title: User Management
user.passwordPolicy: Password must be 8 to 64 characters and no more than 72 bytes
user.changePasswordHelp: Enable only when you need to reset this user's password.
user.primaryRoleHelp: Permissions are merged from all roles; QPS uses only the primary role. It must be assigned to the user.
user.primaryRoleMustBelong: The primary role must be one of the assigned roles
user.banReasonPlaceholder: One line on the main reason, e.g. bulk account registration
user.banEndTimeRequired: Please select the ban end time
user.specifiedResponseHint: When enabled, this user's key calls are not forwarded upstream. The configured content is returned directly. IP whitelist and banned-user checks still apply.
user.specifiedResponseBodyRequired: Please enter the specified response content
user.assetAdjustHint: Adjustments are posted as incremental ledger entries under a row lock, so a concurrent recharge is never overwritten.
user.assetAdjustReasonPlaceholder: e.g. ticket compensation or refund of an incorrect charge
user.assetAdjustEmpty: Enter a balance or points amount to increase or deduct
user.assetAdjustEditHint: Balance and points are now changed only through the incremental Adjust Balance action; editing this profile never touches assets.

menu.name: Menu
menu.activePathMustExist: The path could not find a valid menu

register.title: Registration Management
register.defaultRoleRequired: Select an enabled role that allows public registration
register.defaultRoleQpsSummary: New users join “{0}” with a base quota of {1} QPS
register.newAccountDayLimitHelp: Total calls allowed during the first 24 hours after registration; 0 disables. Applies in addition to the role quota.
register.registerDeviceDayLimitHelp: Accounts one signed browser may create in 24 hours; 0 disables.
register.registerIpPrefixDayLimitHelp: Accounts one IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /64 may create in 24 hours; 0 disables.
register.registerRiskEnabledHelp: Scores email domain, device reuse, submit timing and UA. Turning it off keeps the IP/device/subnet hard caps.
register.registerRiskShadowModeHelp: Record scores without rejecting or quarantining. On by default in this release so enforcement can be evaluated safely.
register.registerRiskQuarantineScoreHelp: At or above this score the new account can sign in but cannot call APIs for 24 hours.
register.registerRiskRejectScoreHelp: At or above this score registration returns a fake success without creating an account. Keep it at least 30 points above quarantine.
register.registerRiskScoreHelp: Score range 0-200; a single weak signal never decides alone.
register.oauthRegisterIpMaxAccounts: Third-party lifetime accounts per IP per provider
register.oauthRequireVerifiedEmail: Require verified email for third-party registration
register.emailWhitelistHint: One domain per line, e.g. example.com (*.example.com allows sub-domains). When non-empty, only whitelisted domains can register
register.emailBlacklistHint: One domain per line. Matched domains are always rejected, e.g. disposable email domains
register.testEmailRequired: Please enter a valid test email
register.testMobileRequired: Please enter a valid test mobile number
register.emailMobileConflict: Mobile registration is enabled. Disable it before enabling email registration.
register.mobileEmailConflict: Email registration is enabled. Disable it before enabling mobile registration.

payment.title: Payment Management
payment.alipayDescription: Alipay Open Platform parameters for balance recharge and package orders.
payment.officialTip: Alipay payments use Open Platform parameters and RSA2 signatures.
payment.officialDescription: Select sandbox or production first, then enter the AppID, app private key, Alipay public key, and callback URLs. Validation parses the keys and generates a real RSA2 signature on the backend without saving or simulating success.
payment.modeHelp: Sandbox and production use different gateways and credentials. Do not mix them.
payment.gatewayUrlHelp: Leave blank to select the official sandbox or production gateway from the runtime mode. Enter a custom URL only for an official-compatible proxy.
payment.gatewayUrlPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the official gateway
payment.sellerIdHelp: Required. Payment notifications and active queries must return the same seller_id to verify the receiving merchant.
payment.notifyUrlHelp: Public backend URL that Alipay calls after payment succeeds, for example: https://your-domain.com/system-api/payment/alipay/notify. It must be reachable by Alipay servers. HTTPS is recommended in production.
payment.notifyUrlAutoPlaceholder: Auto-filled from the current site address when left empty
payment.returnUrlHelp: Frontend page URL that users return to after completing payment in Alipay, for example: https://your-domain.com/#/console/workspace.
payment.privateKeyPlaceholder: Paste the app private key with or without PEM headers. PKCS8 is recommended for Java.
payment.privateKeyRetainHelp: The saved private key is never returned. Leave this blank to keep it, or enter a new value to replace it.
payment.publicKeyPlaceholder: Paste the Alipay public key from Alipay Open Platform.
payment.wechatDescription: Configure WeChat Pay v3 merchant credentials, callbacks, and app IDs for each client.
payment.wechatSecurityDescription: The APIv3 key, merchant private key, and platform public key are never returned in plaintext. Keep ****** or leave a field empty to retain the saved value.
payment.secretRetainPlaceholder: Leave blank or keep ****** to retain the saved value
payment.configDescription: Manage official Alipay, official WeChat Pay, and the two Hupijiao channels while controlling the payment methods shown at checkout.
payment.credentialIsolationDescription: Hupijiao Alipay and WeChat use separate AppIDs and AppSecrets. Every secret is encrypted at rest and only a mask is returned. The backend checks method availability again for every order.
payment.currencyTip: Switch the site settlement currency. CNY is the default: prices and balance show the CNY base value. In USD mode, user-facing prices and balance are converted with the rate below, and online payment orders are charged at the same rate (the original CNY price is kept on the order). The rate can be changed at any time: new orders use it immediately, and open pages refresh on the cache interval.
payment.currencyDisplayNameHelp: Replaces the currency label shown to users. Balances, order amounts and admin reconciliation still use the real currency and exchange rate.
payment.currencyDisplayNameTooLong: Display name is too long (max 16 characters)
payment.currencyRateHelp: 1 USD = X CNY, used for price display and online payment conversion; new orders use the updated rate.
payment.currencyRateInvalid: The rate must be a number greater than 0
payment.goodsNameHelp: The product name sent to WeChat/Alipay and Hupijiao at checkout; the bill shows only this text. Prefer a neutral service wording and avoid terms like top-up, points or package that easily trip risk control. Leave it empty to keep the order detail name (e.g. Balance Recharge - 50 CNY). Order records and reconciliation are unaffected.
payment.goodsNameTooLong: Payment goods name is too long (max 127 bytes, about 42 CJK characters)
payment.sponsorTip: When enabled, a user is added to and switched to the target role below the moment their recharge is credited (same transaction as the balance credit); accounts whose primary role is admin are never switched.
payment.sponsorRoleHelp: Only active non-admin roles are listed; pick the role bundled with sponsor-only packages (e.g. New Sponsor).
payment.sponsorRoleRequired: A target role is required when enabled
payment.hupijiaoCreateUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty for the official api.xunhupay.com/payment/do.html
payment.hupijiaoQueryUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty for the official api.xunhupay.com/payment/query.html
payment.hupijiaoBasicHint: Usually only AppID and AppSecret are required; the notify URL is generated from the current site automatically. Keep the rest as defaults.
payment.methodBalanceDescription: Purchase packages with the account balance. Keeping this enabled is recommended.
payment.methodAlipayDescription: Official Alipay Open Platform channel with RSA2 signatures.
payment.methodWechatDescription: Official WeChat Pay v3 merchant channel.
payment.methodHupijiaoAlipayDescription: Uses a dedicated Hupijiao Alipay AppID and AppSecret.
payment.methodHupijiaoWechatDescription: Uses a dedicated Hupijiao WeChat AppID and AppSecret.
payment.methodTrc20Description: Overseas USDT-TRC20 on-chain top-up, reconciled by address and exact amount.
payment.trc20Tip: When enabled, users can pay with USDT-TRC20: send the exact amount to the address shown, and the backend reconciles every minute. Users may also submit a txid for an immediate check. Balance is still credited in the CNY base.
payment.trc20AddressHelp: Fixed cold-wallet address. Fill it in at launch; never commit it to the repository.
payment.trc20ApiKeyPlaceholder: Optional; leave empty to use the public endpoint
payment.trc20ApiKeyConfigured: Configured; leave empty to keep it
payment.trc20ApiKeyHelp: Stored encrypted. Leave empty to use TronGrid public limits.
payment.trc20ConfirmationsHelp: Only TronGrid-confirmed transfers are supported (value 1); this is not a configurable block depth. Explicitly change a legacy value above 1 to 1 and save before enabling.
payment.trc20AddressRequired: Enter a receiving address before enabling
payment.methodBep20Description: Overseas USDT-BEP20 (BSC) on-chain top-up, reconciled by address and exact amount.
payment.bep20Tip: When enabled, users can pay with USDT-BEP20: send the exact amount to the address shown, and the backend reconciles every minute through a BSC node. Users may also submit a transaction hash for an immediate check. Balance is still credited in the CNY base.
payment.bep20AddressHelp: Fixed receiving address (cold wallet or exchange deposit address). Fill it in at launch; never commit it to the repository.
payment.bep20RpcUrlHelp: Must be an https BSC mainnet node that supports eth_getLogs; it is probed when saved.
payment.bep20ConfirmationsHelp: 15 is recommended (matches Binance BEP20 crediting). Fewer confirmations credit faster but carry more reorg risk.
payment.bep20AddressRequired: Enter a receiving address before enabling

interface.title: Interface Management
interface.batchDeleteConfirm: Delete the {0} selected interfaces? This cannot be undone.
interface.callLogAdminDescription: Review platform results, latency, billing, and risk context, with fast filtering by user and interface.
interface.callLogUserDescription: Review calls made by the current account. Sensitive parameters, addresses, and identity fields are masked.
interface.hideLogConfirmContent: The log will disappear from your list, while system audit and aggregate statistics remain intact.
interface.hideLogSuccess: The call log was hidden from your list
interface.requestIdCopyFailed: Copy failed. Please select the request ID manually.
interface.responseTruncated: The response was truncated: {0} bytes saved from approximately {1} bytes
interface.rawSensitiveConfirmContent: Unmasked logs may contain user parameters, full IP addresses, and response data. Upstream endpoints remain irreversible node references. Enable this only for a necessary security audit.
interface.name: Interface Name
interface.apiCodePlaceholder: Leave blank to auto-generate, e.g. weather_query
interface.avatarUrlPlaceholder: Enter an image URL, or leave blank
interface.requestUrlHelp: If the upstream API needs parameters, put {0} in the parameter value, for example url={0}&phone={0}. Users must pass url and phone when invoking it. Named placeholders like {1} and {2} are also supported.
interface.qpsLimitHelp: Per-user QPS cap for this interface. 0 means unlimited; only restricts the current user. Applies alongside the shared QPS.
interface.sharedQpsLimitHelp: Total QPS capacity shared by all users for this interface. 0 means unlimited. Applies alongside the per-user QPS; whichever triggers first rejects.
interface.callLogKeywordPlaceholder: Search username, interface, params, IP, or error
interface.invokeKeyEmpty: No available keys. Create one in Key Management first.
interface.invokeKeyNoMatch: No matching key is valid for this interface.
interface.loadFailed: Failed to load the API list
interface.keywordPlaceholder: Search interface name, code, or URL
interface.createKeyFirst: Please create and enable a key for this interface first
interface.maintenanceTip: This interface is under maintenance and cannot be invoked now
interface.billingDefaultTip: When no conditions are configured, successful HTTP 2xx/3xx responses are billable by default.
interface.billingRuleTip: A call is charged only when all configured conditions match. The default field is code, and JSON paths such as data.status are also supported.
interface.billingRuleEmpty: No custom billing conditions. Successful responses will be charged by default.
interface.fastQueryHint: The initial range is the last 24 hours. Fast browsing supports an explicit range of up to 31 days. Rows load first; totals are calculated automatically for the current filters and updated on search, pagination, or refresh. Turn it off for longer ranges or numbered page jumps.
interface.fastQueryCountFailed: Counting did not complete. Narrow the time range and retry; the list remains available.
interface.fastQueryHelp: About fast browsing and exact counts

key.title: Key Management
key.createdSecretMissing: The key was created, but the backend did not return the plaintext. Please create a new key and save it.
key.createdSecretTip: The full key is stored encrypted. You can reveal it later from the key list or detail view with the eye button.
key.createdSecretHeaderTip: Send the key in the X-API-Key header. Do not place it in URLs, bookmarks, or browser history.
key.copySecretFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the full key manually.
key.name: Key Name
key.secretRevealFailed: Failed to load the key. Please try again.
key.secretUnavailable: This legacy key has no recoverable plaintext. Create a new key to reveal it.
key.ipWhitelistHint: One IP per line or comma-separated. Leave blank to allow all source IPs.
key.regenerateConfirm: Regenerate the key for "{0}"? The old key will become invalid immediately.
key.accountBanned: This account is banned, so the key cannot be enabled. Lift the ban first.
key.detailPlaintextHint: The key is hidden by default. Use the eye button to show or hide it at any time.

package.title: Package Management
package.name: Package Name
package.serviceTestQuotaHelp: Each sponsor tier includes a daily service testing quota for validating integration and stability; it is set per tier and is not a content licence.
package.totalLimitHelp: Total calls allowed over the package lifetime, 0 = unlimited; enforced together with the daily limit
package.countModeHelp: In "count failures too" mode, calls that fail upstream also consume package quota; in "success only" mode they do not
package.stockLimitHelp: 0 means unlimited; sales stop automatically when sold out
package.perUserLimitHelp: 0 means unlimited; counted by cumulative purchases per user
package.roleRestrictedHelp: When enabled, only the selected user groups can purchase this package
package.roleVisibleOnlyHelp: When checked, users outside the allowed groups cannot see this package in the mall; otherwise everyone can see it but only allowed groups can purchase
package.roleGroupHelp: Multiple selection; only users in the selected groups can purchase this package
package.groupRestricted: Not available for your user group
package.specRequired: At least one spec is required
package.purchaseSuccess: Purchase successful. The amount has been deducted from your balance.
package.orderNotReady: Order payment is not connected yet. Please contact the administrator.
package.documentNotReady: API documentation is not configured yet
package.couponDescription: Current orders use the real-time package price. Coupons will appear here later.
package.globalPackageTip: After purchase, all enabled interfaces can be called. The actual effective time follows the package activation record.
package.interfacePackageTip: After purchase, this package provides call quota for the selected interface. The final quota depends on the selected spec.
package.pointPackageTip: Purchase to add points to the account balance for later API calls or in-system point spending.

assets.title: My Assets
assets.primaryHint: Your primary package is consumed first. Without a primary package, packages are consumed in order of earliest expiry, then the largest quota among packages expiring on the same day. The free role quota is only used after all packages are exhausted. A primary package does not change its own quota or validity.
assets.freeQuotaHint: Free calls included in your role, counted separately per minute, hour, day and month. Each window resets automatically. The free quota is only used after all packages are exhausted.
assets.paidQuotaHint: Packages are consumed before the free role quota: earliest expiry first by default, or your primary package first when set. The free quota is only used after all packages are exhausted.
assets.quotaDisabled: Your role has no total call limit
assets.counterUnavailable: Usage counters are temporarily unavailable, please refresh later
assets.newAccountHint: Applies within 24 hours after registration, counted together with the role free quota, and expires automatically.

package.userKeywordPlaceholder: Search username, user ID or package name
package.forceDeleteConfirm: "{0}" has purchase/entitlement records, so the normal delete was rejected. Force delete also removes every user's entitlement of this package; purchase and payment records are kept for audit. This cannot be undone.
package.hiddenHelp: When enabled, this package is invisible and unpurchasable for everyone in the mall; it can only be delivered to users via "Grant packages"
package.grantUsersPlaceholder: One username or user ID per line, up to 200 per batch
package.grantEndAtPlaceholder: Leave empty to use the package's valid days
package.grantEndAtHelp: Applies to global/interface packages only; point packages grant points balance with no expiry
package.grantHelp: Granting charges no balance and ignores mall sale restrictions; repeated grants stack entitlements, which can be revoked or adjusted in the list below

about.title: About
about.description: BugPk-Api is an open-source API aggregation platform that provides interface documentation, online testing, key management and call statistics.
about.author: Author
about.openSourceNote: This project is released under an open-source license. Stars, issues and contributions are welcome. All APIs are for learning and legal use only.

operationLog.personalScope: Only your own logins and important console actions are shown. API calls, automatic refreshes and public page visits are excluded.
operationLog.adminScope: Only administrator logins and important management actions are shown. User actions are kept in each user’s personal activity log.

openApi.title: Open API
openApi.adminTip: Manage Open API keys across all accounts; the plaintext secret is shown only once after issuance or reset.
openApi.configTip: When the global switch is off, keys cannot be issued or reset and existing keys return 403 (openapi.disabled). Changes take effect immediately without a restart.
openApi.enabledHelp: When disabled, issuing new keys is blocked and all Open API endpoints return 403. Use it as an emergency kill switch.
openApi.ipWhitelistMaxHelp: Maximum number of IP whitelist entries per key, between 0 and 100.
openApi.keyDefaultExpireDaysHelp: Used for normal-scope keys issued without an explicit expiry, between 1 and 3650.
openApi.adminKeyExpireDaysHelp: Used for admin-scope keys issued without an explicit expiry, between 1 and 3650.
openApi.rateLimitNormalHelp: Per-minute request limit for a single normal key. 0 means unlimited.
openApi.rateLimitAdminHelp: Per-minute request limit for a single admin-scope key. 0 means unlimited.
openApi.scopeHelp: Select at least one endpoint permission; admin-scope endpoints are only selectable for accounts holding the matching role permission.
openApi.scopeRequired: Select at least one endpoint permission
openApi.userSelectPlaceholder: Search by username and pick an account
openApi.secretWarn: The plaintext secret is shown only this one time after issuance or reset. Store it safely — it cannot be viewed again.
openApi.copyFailed: Copy failed, please select the text and copy it manually
openApi.resetConfirmContent: The current secret of "{0}" will stop working immediately. Save the new plaintext right away.
openApi.revokeConfirmContent: After revocation, "{0}" can no longer call the Open API. This cannot be undone.
openApi.ipWhitelistHelp: Optional. Separate multiple CIDRs or IPs with commas or spaces. Leave empty to allow any source IP.
openApi.expiresInDaysHelp: Leave empty to use the platform default expiry.
openApi.endpoint: Open API base URL: {0}. Send the key as the request header X-Open-Key: {1}
openApi.switchDisabledSuccess: Open API access disabled; your keys are temporarily inactive
